import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007;
    static long N, K;
    static Matrix[][] mat = new Matrix[70][35];

    static class Matrix {
        long[][] A;
        int n, m;

        Matrix(int n, int m) {
            this.n = n;
            this.m = m;
            A = new long[n][m];
        }

        Matrix(int n) {
            this(n, n);
        }

        static Matrix identity(int n) {
            Matrix mat = new Matrix(n);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                mat.A[i][i] = 1;
            }
            return mat;
        }

        Matrix add(Matrix B) {
            assert n == B.n && m == B.m;
            Matrix C = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    C.A[i][j] = (A[i][j] + B.A[i][j]) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return C;
        }

        Matrix subtract(Matrix B) {
            assert n == B.n && m == B.m;
            Matrix C = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    C.A[i][j] = (A[i][j] - B.A[i][j] + MOD) % MOD;
                }
            }
            return C;
        }

        Matrix multiply(Matrix B) {
            assert m == B.n;
            Matrix C = new Matrix(n, B.m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < B.m; j++) {
                    long sum = 0;
                    for (int k = 0; k < m; k++) {
                        sum = (sum + A[i][k] * B.A[k][j]) % MOD;
                    }
                    C.A[i][j] = sum;
                }
            }
            return C;
        }

        Matrix power(long k) {
            Matrix B = identity(n);
            Matrix base = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    base.A[i][j] = A[i][j];
                }
            }
            while (k > 0) {
                if ((k & 1) == 1) {
                    B = B.multiply(base);
                }
                base = base.multiply(base);
                k >>= 1;
            }
            return B;
        }

        void rot() {
            Matrix B = new Matrix(n, m);
            for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < K; j++) {
                    B.A[i][j] = A[(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K][(j + (int)K - 1) % (int)K];
                }
                B.A[i][(int)K] = A[(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K][(int)K];
                B.A[(int)K][i] = A[(int)K][(i + (int)K - 1) % (int)K];
            }
            B.A[(int)K][(int)K] = A[(int)K][(int)K];
            for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
                for (int j = 0; j < m; j++) {
                    A[i][j] = B.A[i][j];
                }
            }
        }
    }

    static long beki(long a, long b) {
        if (b == 0) return 1;
        long ret = beki(a, b / 2);
        ret = (ret * ret) % MOD;
        if (b % 2 == 1) {
            ret = (ret * a) % MOD;
        }
        return ret;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws Exception {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = sc.nextLong();
        K = sc.nextLong();

        long INDEX = 0;
        long copy = N;
        while (copy >= K) {
            INDEX++;
            copy /= K;
        }

        mat[0][0] = Matrix.identity((int)K + 1);
        for (int i = 1; i < K + 1; i++) {
            mat[0][0].A[0][i] = 1;
        }

        for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
            mat[0][i] = new Matrix(mat[0][i-1].n, mat[0][i-1].m);
            for (int x = 0; x < mat[0][i-1].n; x++) {
                for (int y = 0; y < mat[0][i-1].m; y++) {
                    mat[0][i].A[x][y] = mat[0][i-1].A[x][y];
                }
            }
            mat[0][i].rot();
        }

        for (int index = 1; index <= INDEX; index++) {
            mat[index][0] = new Matrix(mat[index-1][0].n, mat[index-1][0].m);
            for (int x = 0; x < mat[index-1][0].n; x++) {
                for (int y = 0; y < mat[index-1][0].m; y++) {
                    mat[index][0].A[x][y] = mat[index-1][0].A[x][y];
                }
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                mat[index][0] = mat[index-1][i].multiply(mat[index][0]);
            }
            for (int i = 1; i < K; i++) {
                mat[index][i] = new Matrix(mat[index][i-1].n, mat[index][i-1].m);
                for (int x = 0; x < mat[index][i-1].n; x++) {
                    for (int y = 0; y < mat[index][i-1].m; y++) {
                        mat[index][i].A[x][y] = mat[index][i-1].A[x][y];
                    }
                }
                mat[index][i].rot();
            }
        }

        Matrix ans = new Matrix((int)K + 1, 1);
        ans.A[(int)K][0] = 1;
        int used = 0;

        while (INDEX >= 0) {
            for (int i = 0; ; i++) {
                if (beki(K, INDEX) <= N) {
                    N -= beki(K, INDEX);
                    ans = mat[(int)INDEX][used].multiply(ans);
                    used++;
                    used %= (int)K;
                } else {
                    break;
                }
            }
            INDEX--;
        }

        long val = 0;
        for (int i = 0; i < K + 1; i++) {
            val = (val + ans.A[i][0]) % MOD;
        }
        System.out.println(val);
    }
}
